page.content:
Macbeth's wife who goads the murder and later sleepwalks with a stain.

How Lady Macbeth connects

  • Work: Macbeth — Lady Macbeth is the partner who plans Duncan's murder.
  • Character: Macbeth (thane) — Lady Macbeth goads Macbeth into killing the king.

What is Lady Macbeth?

Lady Macbeth is the partner who calls on spirits to unsex her, plans Duncan's death, and then walks the castle at night trying to wash a spot that will not leave.

Key threads lead to Macbeth and Macbeth (thane).
